title: Widget typography dashboard, round filtering, and preview stability
content:
A comprehensive update to the JeffersonWM typography management dashboard brings round-based typeface filtering, instant weight previews, direct Google Fonts specimen links, and session-sync stabilization.

Key highlights:

  • Round Filtering & Badges (R1 – R8): Added complete dictionary mapping for all 213 fonts across 8 release rounds with round badge indicators and toolbar filter pills.
  • Direct Google Fonts Links: Connected every typeface card title directly to its official Google Fonts specimen page (https://fonts.google.com/specimen/...) with external link indicators.
  • Instant Sample Text Weight Updates: Mapped weight scale buttons (1–5) to live font weights (300, 400, 500, 700, 900) that update preview samples in real-time on click.
  • Defaults & Bulk Reset: Established default weight (3) and probability (3) with a dedicated ↺ Reset All (3/3) toolbar action and backend endpoint (POST /api/widget/fonts/reset-all) connected to central auth logging.
  • Preview Stability & Session Optimization: Guarded background auth checks to prevent periodic full-grid DOM reloads every 4 seconds, keeping sample text steady while maintaining cross-site session sync.
